dedupe_keys.name: centraline semaforiche posizionamento e sensoristica a bordo

description: The municipality of Bari publishes an inventory of traffic-signal controllers and onboard detectors at major city intersections. Hierarchical JSON metadata describes controller names, usually formed from intersecting street names, and latitude and longitude. The combined device_db, device_type, device_id and detector_id fields form a key for linking traffic-flow measurements to detector direction. Eleven listed JSON resources are labelled by month from August 2025 through June 2026. Controller locations and detector references can connect observed traffic flows to road-network simulation inputs. The catalogue metadata was modified on 6 July 2026; its separate issued and modified fields use other dates, so metadata timestamps do not establish observation coverage beyond the listed months. Positional accuracy and coordinate reference system are unspecified. Creative Commons Attribution is stated without a version; cost and download access conditions remain unverified. No files were downloaded. Related records contain daily traffic flows and a separate traffic-light installation inventory. Their scopes overlap, but the controller-specific keys establish a distinct resource.
